__doc__: v7.1 M9 — per-scale tool_use budgets for sub-agents. PM injects the relevant budget into each Agent spawn. Exceeding is non-fatal but flagged: the agent writes a budget-exceeded.json marker inside artifactDir, and vela-stop.js rolls it into tool-usage.json for /vela:analyze reporting. Numbers derive from hicoco session telemetry: executor avg 57.7 (max 88), verifier 55.2 (max 92), reviewer 16.1 (max 41). Large-scale budgets leave ~40% slack above the observed averages so healthy pipelines don't flag, only outliers do.
